relationships.subject: Nano-PAZII
relationships.evidence_quote: The injection of Nano-PAZII blocks VEGFR1 and relieves OA pain by suppressing sensory neuronal ingrowth into the knee synovium and neuronal plasticity in the dorsal root ganglia and spinal cord.

key_findings: A single intraarticular injection of Nano-PAZII relieved OA pain for over 16 weeks and reduced cartilage degeneration in two rodent OA models.
Nano-PAZII reduced VEGFA/NGF/TrkA signaling, CGRP and TRPV1 in DRG and astrocyte/microglia activation in spinal dorsal horn.
